# Love Pathways Wraparound

> Love-based, trauma-responsive wraparound services for adoptive families in California, at no out-of-pocket cost to Adoption Assistance Program (AAP) families. A program of Revive Behavioral Healthcare, grounded in a love-based, family-centered methodology and founded by adoption and child-behavior expert Bryan Post.

Love Pathways Wraparound helps adoptive families heal and stay together through education, family coaching, parent groups, and in-home support across 10 California counties (Merced, Calaveras, Contra Costa, San Joaquin, Stanislaus, Alameda, Santa Clara, Madera, Fresno, and Tulare). No referral is required: if your adopted child is under 18 and your family receives AAP benefits, you likely qualify automatically. The program operates only within California.

## Core pages
- [Our Program](https://lovepathways.org/our-program): The wraparound model, its four phases (Engagement, Plan Development, Implementation, Transition), eligibility criteria, and the 10 California counties served.
- [About Love Pathways](https://lovepathways.org/about-us): Mission, vision, core values (Love, Integrity, Relationship, Responsibility, Effort), and founder Bryan Post's love-based philosophy.
- [Our Team](https://lovepathways.org/our-team): Clinical and program leadership, including Executive Director Dr. Williams, Clinical Director Jeanette Yoffe, Director of Operations Marissa, and Wraparound Manager Shing.
- [Our Impact](https://lovepathways.org/impact): Hundreds of adoptive families supported across California, with real stories and outcomes.
- [FAQ](https://lovepathways.org/faq): Eligibility, cost, what wraparound care means, counties served, and how to get started.
- [Contact](https://lovepathways.org/contact-us): Reach the Love Pathways team in Sacramento, CA for support, referrals, or partnership inquiries.

## Resources & Events
- [Resource Hub](https://lovepathways.org/resource-hub): Free guides, books, recorded webinars, and tools for adoptive parents on trauma-responsive parenting.
- [Events & Webinars](https://lovepathways.org/events): Upcoming free webinars and workshops for adoptive families in California.
- [Blog](https://lovepathways.org/blog): Articles on trauma-responsive parenting, adoption challenges, and the love-based methodology.
